4279-4314-5933--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4314-5933--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Repeat.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.

Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

When Moseo dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Moseo from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.

2685-4186-4321-6996.description:
Gain life.

Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4478-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
4478-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

4460-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4460-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4460-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:

When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller

Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
437-662-1651-5640.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

Archangel of Thune and Spider-Man trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite and one +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

2645-2919-4929-6824.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

Once you have infinite Jace tokens with infinite loyalty counters, starting on your next turn, you may activate any number of instances of the second ability granted by Ichormoon Gauntlet by removing loyalty counters from Jace tokens to take infinite turns.

Resolve the first Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat from step 3.
